definitions.supplemental: Cf. Goth. Gut-þiuda the Gothic people.

quotations.old_english: Hú se Gota geneádod ágeaf Furtunate þá cnapan
Wisle lond, and be-eástan þǽm sint Datia, þá þe iú wǽron Gotan
Hú Bonefatius þám Gotan gefyllde þá flaxan. Hit gelamp þ-bar; him cómon twégen men tó of Gotena þeóde, þá sǽdon þ-bar; hí tó Rauennan faran woldon

source_text: Gota. Add :-- Sum Gota þearfa on gáste Gothus quidam pauper spiritu, Gr. D. 113, 15. Hú se Gota geneádod ágeaf Furtunate þá cnapan, 79, 8. Wisle lond, and be-eástan þǽm sint Datia, þá þe iú wǽron Gotan, Ors. 1, 1; S. 16, 18. Hú Bonefatius þám Gotan gefyllde þá flaxan. Hit gelamp þ-bar; him cómon twégen men tó of Gotena þeóde, þá sǽdon þ-bar; hí tó Rauennan faran woldon, Gr. D. 66, 3-7. [Cf. Goth. Gut-þiuda the Gothic people.]
